science_guardrails: Fire-ant workers have six thoracic legs, two waist nodes, elbowed antennae, and a darker gaster.
The mound is an irregular soil dome with no central opening; tunnels and chamber positions are illustrative.
Brood are pale eggs, legless larvae, and exposed pupae. Show no fixed depth, temperature, treatment, or certain survival.

shots.visual: Close nursery chamber: a worker tends a large pale larva, exposed pupa, and eggs; another young adult comes into view.

beats.action: Brood and tending worker are already moving; worker antennae point toward larva.
Pale larva wriggles and the pupa rocks gently.
Young pale adult worker walks into the chamber from the right.
Tending worker touches the brood with antennae.

shots.camera: Slow push toward the brood with a small left drift.

shots.visual: Pull back from the brood to a nest cutaway; upper chambers and moving workers come into view.

beats.action: Pull back, keeping brood visible within its chamber.
A lime paper halo pops around the nursery chamber.
The full irregular mound and connected chambers enter frame.

shots.camera: Accelerating zoom out and slight upward tilt.

shots.visual: Full nest cutaway with a sunlit upper chamber and damp lower soil. Worker traffic continues between them.

beats.action: Cool blue dampness appears in lower soil while warm light touches the mound.
Two upper brood chambers fill with visible brood and lime rings pulse around them.

shots.camera: Push through the cutaway with a gentle lateral drift.

shots.visual: Cold grey clouds slide over the mound; rain begins and splashes against the surface. The mound stays closed at its crown.

beats.action: Hard cut to the nest under a changing sky.
Grey clouds cover the sun and the sky turns blue-grey.
First raindrops strike the surface.
Rain thickens and shallow surface puddles spread.

shots.camera: Push in on the mound as clouds drift in the opposite direction.

shots.visual: Inside the nest, several workers with brood begin moving along an ascending tunnel toward the upper chamber.

beats.action: Three workers become visible in the sloping corridor.
Lead worker picks up a curved larva.
Carrier advances uphill; two others follow, separated along the tunnel.

shots.camera: Track uphill beside the lead worker.
shots.transition_in: Hard cut into the underground corridor.

shots.visual: The brood carrier climbs into an upper chamber directly below the mound; other workers are already tending brood there.

beats.action: Camera tilts upward as carrier climbs toward the chamber.
A second upper chamber comes into view.
Carrier enters the upper nursery and sets the larva among the brood.

shots.camera: Track upward, then push toward the chamber.

shots.words: where they can take advantage of sunlight
shots.visual: Above the upper nursery, clouds part. Sunlight lands on the mound and a warm glow reaches the shallow soil around the brood.

beats.action: Hard cut to a mound and upper nursery close view.
Clouds begin sliding apart.
Sun rays turn toward the mound.
Sun appears; a wide amber light patch brightens upper soil and brood.

shots.camera: Push down from sun and mound toward the upper chamber.

shots.visual: Close view of a worker placing a larva with the upper brood, while blue wet soil is visible farther below across the cutaway.

beats.action: Cut to upper chamber with carrying worker entering.
Worker steps onto the dry upper chamber floor.
Worker sets larva beside a pupa and eggs.
Camera widens to show clear vertical separation from blue wet lower soil.

shots.camera: Track the larva, then pull back to include the lower soil.

shots.visual: Wide cutaway: moving blue water saturates lower soil while the brood remains in upper chambers under the mound; workers keep moving.

beats.action: Blue water rises through the bottom soil and ripples, stopping below the upper chambers.
Camera pushes toward the wet lower soil, then eases back to keep upper brood in view.

shots.camera: Push toward rippling water, then drift upward for the next hot-weather sentence.
